title: Confirm the Decisions section of CLAUDE.md entry by entry
body:
An earlier Claude session wrote the byte-for-byte round-trip goal into CLAUDE.md as a settled decision, and Jack never wanted it. The rest of the Decisions section reads in the same voice. Go through it with Jack one entry at a time and mark each as his, amended, or dropped.

Entries, as of 0.3.0:
- name toil (renamed from tabl on 2026-09-25)
- per-column numeric formatting in scope, unit formatting out
- rows are untyped
- streaming is first-class; Stream takes its Widths at construction and never revises them
- pail's floor generalises, its blocks do not
- a reader for everything the crate writes, for the data and not the style
- dependencies are allowed
- rendering has no error type; reading has ParseError

Known to be Jack's already: dependencies allowed (commit 3f59694), breaking changes below 1.0 (f39c493), and the reader being for data, not style. The 2026-09-07 entries came out of the first design session and have not been checked.
